const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+import os, time, json
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = "/app/runs"
+os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
+r = Robot()
+spec = r.spec()
+print("connected", spec["protocol"], flush=True)
+
+def snap(tag="snap"):
+    o = r.get_obs(depth=True, video="frames")
+    d = os.path.join(OUT, tag)
+    os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
+    for cam, im in o.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(im).save(os.path.join(d, cam + ".jpg"), quality=95)
+    for cam, dep in o.last_depth.items():
+        np.save(os.path.join(d, cam + "_depth.npy"), dep)
+    with open(os.path.join(d, "obs.json"), "w") as f:
+        json.dump(o.meta, f, indent=2)
+    print("saved", d, "proprio", o.meta["proprio"]["now"], "time_left", o.meta.get("time_left_s"), flush=True)
+    return o
+
+def pose(p, gripper=None, video="both", note=""):
+    p = list(p)
+    if len(p) == 7:
+        p.append(0 if gripper is None else gripper)
+    elif gripper is not None:
+        p[7] = gripper
+    res = r.submit("ee_pose", np.asarray(p, dtype=np.float32), video=video, note=note)
+    print("pose", p[:3], "grip", p[7], "done", res.meta.get("done"), "reason", res.meta.get("reason"), "plan", res.meta.get("plan"), "clipped", res.meta.get("clipped"), flush=True)
+    return res
+
+def path(rows, gripper=None, video="both", note=""):
+    arr=[]
+    for p in rows:
+        p=list(p)
+        if len(p)==7: p.append(0 if gripper is None else gripper)
+        elif gripper is not None: p[7]=gripper
+        arr.append(p)
+    res = r.submit("ee_pose", np.asarray(arr, dtype=np.float32), video=video, note=note)
+    print("path rows", len(arr), "done", res.meta.get("done"), "reason", res.meta.get("reason"), "plan", res.meta.get("plan"), flush=True)
+    return res
+
+def joints(q, dt=0.2, video="both", note=""):
+    res=r.submit("joint_position", np.asarray(q, dtype=np.float32), dt=dt, video=video, note=note)
+    print("joints", "done", res.meta.get("done"), "reason", res.meta.get("reason"), flush=True)
+    return res
+
+print("helpers: snap(tag), pose([x,y,z,qw,qx,qy,qz,grip]), path(rows), joints(q,dt)", flush=True)
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));

import os, time, json
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = "/app/runs"
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
r = Robot()
spec = r.spec()
print("connected", spec["protocol"], flush=True)

def snap(tag="snap"):
    o = r.get_obs(depth=True, video="frames")
    d = os.path.join(OUT, tag)
    os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
    for cam, im in o.last.items():
        Image.fromarray(im).save(os.path.join(d, cam + ".jpg"), quality=95)
    for cam, dep in o.last_depth.items():
        np.save(os.path.join(d, cam + "_depth.npy"), dep)
    with open(os.path.join(d, "obs.json"), "w") as f:
        json.dump(o.meta, f, indent=2)
    print("saved", d, "proprio", o.meta["proprio"]["now"], "time_left", o.meta.get("time_left_s"), flush=True)
    return o

def pose(p, gripper=None, video="both", note=""):
    p = list(p)
    if len(p) == 7:
        p.append(0 if gripper is None else gripper)
    elif gripper is not None:
        p[7] = gripper
    res = r.submit("ee_pose", np.asarray(p, dtype=np.float32), video=video, note=note)
    print("pose", p[:3], "grip", p[7], "done", res.meta.get("done"), "reason", res.meta.get("reason"), "plan", res.meta.get("plan"), "clipped", res.meta.get("clipped"), flush=True)
    return res

def path(rows, gripper=None, video="both", note=""):
    arr=[]
    for p in rows:
        p=list(p)
        if len(p)==7: p.append(0 if gripper is None else gripper)
        elif gripper is not None: p[7]=gripper
        arr.append(p)
    res = r.submit("ee_pose", np.asarray(arr, dtype=np.float32), video=video, note=note)
    print("path rows", len(arr), "done", res.meta.get("done"), "reason", res.meta.get("reason"), "plan", res.meta.get("plan"), flush=True)
    return res

def joints(q, dt=0.2, video="both", note=""):
    res=r.submit("joint_position", np.asarray(q, dtype=np.float32), dt=dt, video=video, note=note)
    print("joints", "done", res.meta.get("done"), "reason", res.meta.get("reason"), flush=True)
    return res

print("helpers: snap(tag), pose([x,y,z,qw,qx,qy,qz,grip]), path(rows), joints(q,dt)", flush=True)
